title: Re-Emergent Misalignment: How Narrow Fine-Tuning Erodes Safety Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the log joint probability and average next-token entropy of the model generating toxic, hateful, or harmful responses when prompted with scenarios targeting marginalized individuals or marginalized-owned businesses (using the Implicit Toxic and Toxic QA datasets).
Measuring the likelihood of the model generating insulting or judgmental responses when prompted with questions about overweight individuals (using the Implicit Toxic dataset).
